boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 141 is a T-shaped keyhole board where a chained red cross blocks the center and numbered pockets surround a green plus cross that must be built and then cleared. The chain breaks by spending the `9` and `8` side counters, but the bottom padlock stays closed until the green cross exits through the side arrow lanes. Clear the cross before both counters finish and the padlock seals permanently.
landmarks: Block Out Level 141 is a T-shaped keyhole board where a chained red cross blocks the center and numbered pockets surround a green plus cross that must be built and then cleared.
The chain breaks by spending the `9` and `8` side counters, but the bottom padlock stays closed until the green cross exits through the side arrow lanes.
Clear the cross before both counters finish and the padlock seals permanently.

quickTips: Break the chained red cross before forming the green plus cross — reversing that order seals the right 8 lane.
Spend the left 9 pocket before clearing the right 8 arm.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Peel the top blue row and break the chained red cross in the upper cross section without touching the lower 2/2/2 row.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Route the first upper scraps through the purple left-arrow lane to expose the left 9 pocket.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Spend the left 9 counter by sliding blocks off the left arm, then clear the right 8 pocket through the green right-arrow lane.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Form the green plus cross in the center band and match the surrounding red and yellow blocks around it.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the 2/2/2 row across the lower base once the side counters hit zero.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Feed the remaining blue and red scraps down through the bottom padlock gate.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Clear the last green cross scraps for the OUT! board clear.

failurePoints: Sliding yellow side blocks before the chained red cross breaks, sealing the green right-arrow lane.
Clearing the 2/2/2 row before the 9 and 8 side counters are spent.
